channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Paul Reed | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Paul Reed from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Paul Reed
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff on Paul Reed:

“At that moment, what we needed is what P Reed provides and he provides that spark, that instant impact to make plays.”

JB Bickerstaff on Paul Reed, May 9, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Paul Reed
item.description:
Asked to comment on Sunday, Nurse replied,

“I don’t have a response. We certainly didn’t think Paul Reed was a problem.”

Nick Nurse on Paul Reed, Mar 17, 2025. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed
item.description:
“Tobias Harris, whom I've known for a long time. We've got Malik Beasley, Tim Hardaway Jr, and Paul Reed coming in. I feel very good about the offseason with the veterans. I think Trajan Langdon did a good job bringing the right people in, but still keeping flexibility.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed, Oct 9, 2024. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Paul Reed
item.description:
said Nurse on Wednesday.

“He’s been really close on some stuff. It just hasn’t bounced his way but it isn’t for lack of effort or anything. You kinda gotta, again, short memory. He got his hands on a bunch of balls last night that normally he probably grabs and sticks one or two of those back in and all that, but it just doesn’t happen. I’m not worried about his effort level.”

Nick Nurse on Paul Reed, May 2, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Tobias Harris on Paul Reed
item.description:
“So that was huge, but all the young guys. Especially, P-Reed. I’m in his ear. I’m always encouraging him when we’re on the floor because I want him to be successful out there and I think he’s gonna be a great player.”

Tobias Harris on Paul Reed, Jan 13, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Doc Rivers on DeAndre Jordan, Paul Reed
item.description:
Doc on the decision to go with Paul Reed over DeAndre Jordan off the bench:

“It wasn’t much of a decision for us. Paul basically played the same role that he played in the first two games and that’s where we liked him, coming off the bench and matching him up in those minutes.”

Doc Rivers on DeAndre Jordan, Paul Reed, May 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @NBAKrell.
